limitation: Target repository returned 404 through GitHub connector; target contents unverified.
assumption: A successor web application for existing AAC users

tasks.title: Define one target user and core improvement
tasks.task: In the confirmed UniBloom working copy, agree and document the target user, one problem, core journey, acceptance criteria and excluded scope before implementation.

acceptance_criteria.description: README defines target user, problem, journey and excluded scope; user agreement recorded.

tasks.test_approach_rationale: Product scope proposal requires human review.
tasks.alternative_verification: Review README against AC1 and record unresolved decisions.

tasks.title: Inspect destination and define migration baseline
tasks.task: Inspect the destination repository with read-only operations, record source commit and destination state, and document a history-preserving migration procedure with private data exclusions and startup validation; do not overwrite existing destination work.

acceptance_criteria.description: Migration document identifies repository states, source commit, exclusions and reproducible validation steps.

tasks.test_approach_rationale: Migration planning only; execution checks must be selected from the confirmed baseline.
tasks.alternative_verification: Review migration document against observed source and target states.

tasks.title: Specify the first improvement
tasks.task: Specify one agreed improvement with before/after journey, affected screens, API contracts or explicit unchanged boundaries, data handling and behavior-based verification criteria; defer execution tasks until repository baseline is verified.

acceptance_criteria.description: First-improvement spec includes user journey, boundaries, error, offline and accessibility criteria.

tasks.alternative_verification: Review all AC3 elements and derive implementation checks from actual repository tooling.
